title: Modernize Domestic Violence Protection Order
lastAction: Ref To Com On Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill modifies North Carolina's domestic violence protection order law to ensure that same-sex couples can obtain protective orders. Currently, the law limits dating relationship protections to 'persons of the opposite sex,' which excludes same-sex couples from this category of protection.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this bill ensures equal protection under the law for all North Carolinians, regardless of sexual orientation. They contend that same-sex couples experience domestic violence at similar rates to opposite-sex couples and deserve the same legal protections, including emergency protective orders that can be obtained quickly without a hearing.
aiConArguments: Opponents may argue about the scope of changes to existing law or express concerns about how courts should implement expanded protections. Some may question whether other sections of the law also need updating to ensure consistency, though the bill's narrow focus on dating relationships suggests this addresses a specific gap in current statute.
